messages.subject_clean: M, GC and N files for 750bp
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I was wondering if you could please share M, GC and N files for binSize= 750 bp. I am calling broad peaks for histone modifications and my fragment lengths were larger than usual. I am getting the following error with small binSize during model fitting: insufficient # of proper strata! Cannot proceed!

I think that this can be circumvented if I tried larger binSizes. I will appreciate your help with this.

Thanks,
Sid
